scripts.check: bun run format -- --check && bun run lint && tsc --noEmit
scripts.format: oxfmt browser index.html node scripts test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings browser node scripts test vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.test: bun run build && node --no-node-snapshot node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && node --no-node-snapshot node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage
